scenario.prompt: Build the widgets.json for "Chain TVL Data" at http://localhost:7802. It has exactly one entry, `gas_priority_metric`: name "Gas Priority", description "Priority gas fee monitor.", endpoint /gas-priority, type metric, sized w=6 h=4 on the grid, category "Network Ops", runButton true; it auto-refreshes every 30 seconds. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000.. Then add the backend.
scenario.title: Compose the Gas Priority content widget

notes: Write one JSON object per line.
Use only tools listed in scenario.allowed_tools.
The harness executes calls after the command exits and grades final state.
